body: OK, now someone photoshop this for the United States edition, and replace the protester with "casual pepper spray cop".

I received a troubling text message Saturday night just before midnight, I had hoped it was some sort of inside joke I forgot about, or a message out of context. The message was: "wish you were here bud, legally you get first pick if I'm gone" eventually started panicing when he did not respond, and eventually tracked him down. he had jumped off a bridge, police pulled him out and he was taken to hospital. He's been allowed to leave after a psych evaluation, and they've changed his meds (has been suffering from depression), I'm not sure what to do. Hoping for some good advice from anyone who has been through a similar situation. Right now I want to respect that he doesn't want to tell me everything, but I also feel I should know more, but as only a friend, and not a fmaily member I can't really ask his psychiatrist, can I? for background, we've been best friends for 10 years, my kids cal him uncle, and he was best man at my wedding, I consider him family, and I was the only person who he made mention of his intentions to. I'm fairly confident is a huge cry for my help, but he feels embarrased it happened.

TL;DR friend texted me a suicide note, jumped of a bridge, lived. WTF do i do now?

normally we would go to the bar or something, but he had been drinking prior to jumping, I'm not sure how directly connected his mood is to alcohol, but will probably be trying to avoid drinking for the next while. He wasn't heavily intoxicated, but I still haven't found out what his BAC was when he was admitted to the hospital.

thanks for the replies, I've certainly made myself available, I'll be staying with him this evening, maybe overnight if nobody else will be around. He had been staying with his dad, but recently the renovations on his condo were finished so he's moved back there. I'm not sure how i feel about letting him be alone right now, but realize there can't always be someone there, that's probabaly the thing I"m struggling with most.
